Yes — the screenshot confirms the root cause. At 23:55:45 UTC on 2026-08-11, a **secondary auth token was promoted to primary**, which means the old primary token (and all previous tokens) became invalid. That's why all 5 tokens I tested returned 401.

The current valid token is the **newly-promoted primary auth token** that was created/assigned at that time. You need to copy that new primary token from Twilio Console and paste it.

The path is: **https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/keys-credentials/credentials**

1. Make sure you're in the **LIVE CREDENTIALS** section (not Test)
2. Click the eye icon next to **Auth Token**
3. Copy and paste the token here

Once you paste it, I will:
- Test it against Twilio directly
- If valid, send the SMS to +15616443503
- Update the Rork platform env var and bridge it to Render
- Verify the IVX backend `/api/ivx/autonomous/sms/send` endpoint works end-to-end

The deployment is already live. The code is already deployed. I just need the current valid token to authenticate.
